sources.reviewed_depth: Full text retrieved; relevant methods, outcome, analysis and limitation sections reviewed; independent review pending.

sources.reviewed_depth: Full text retrieved; trial design, primary outcomes, reported effects, safety and limitation sections reviewed; independent review pending.

calcium_hmb.population: 34 adults aged >=60 with sarcopenia; n=18 calcium-HMB, n=16 placebo
calcium_hmb.preparation: NOURIGEN powder; 3 g sachet contained 1.5 g calcium-HMB; twice daily for 12 weeks
calcium_hmb.cointervention: both groups received supervised resistance exercise twice weekly
calcium_hmb.body_composition: No significant differences in skeletal muscle mass, skeletal muscle index or other body-composition measures were reported.
calcium_hmb.missing_data: Last observation carried forward was used for dropout-related missing data.
calcium_hmb.competitive_role: highest-priority newly surfaced common-supplement functional reserve; not an MVA/BUB1B lead

week8_primary_grip_contrast.interpretation: non-significant; do not omit when emphasizing the week-12 result

calcium_hmb.formulation_limit: Calcium-HMB salt as tested; do not assume free-acid dose or retail-product equivalence.

inulin.population: knee osteoarthritis; mean age 67.5 years; mean BMI 29.5 kg/m2
inulin.design: 2x2 factorial RCT, 136 randomized, 117 completed; 20 g/day inulin, exercise, combination, or 10 g/day maltodextrin for six weeks
design_limitations: exercise-arm dropout was 17/81 versus 2/55 in non-exercise arms
allocation probabilities changed during later recruitment to over-recruit exercise arms
ClinicalTrials.gov first posting followed actual study start
inulin.competitive_role: lower-priority common-fiber reserve; symptom and secondary grip signal, not a BUB1B/MVA lead

decision: Keep niacin/restoration and apitegromab/function as separate core hypotheses. Vitamin D2 is conditional on measured deficiency/malabsorption, calcium-HMB is the strongest common-supplement functional reserve in the reviewed pairwise comparison with inulin, and inulin remains exploratory. None of these batch11 routes displaces the core pair or has demonstrated MVA benefit.

vitamin_d2_conditional_reserve.population: 84 adults aged 18-70 with chronic intestinal failure and baseline 25(OH)D <30 ng/mL
vitamin_d2_conditional_reserve.intervention: Intramuscular vitamin D2 600,000 IU every two weeks for 10 weeks; total 3 million IU
vitamin_d2_conditional_reserve.control: Matched placebo; both groups standard care, with nutrition and activity monitored
limitations: Very high injectable exposure and only 12-week observation
No MVA, BUB1B, BUBR1 or chromosome-fidelity endpoint
vitamin_d2_conditional_reserve.competitive_role: Strongest controlled function signal among these three batch11 full-text leads, conditional on comparable deficiency; not a general MVA candidate
